description: A WebRTC ingress descriptor or one session of it. A listen record names the requester's ingress; offer and answer records carry the SDP for one peer and reference the listen record.

id.description: The requester's ingress id: hex sha256 of the requester repo DID.

peer.description: The other party: the target bidder of an offer, the requester of an answer.

session.description: A per-offer nonce; an answer applies only to the offer with the same id and session.

descriptor.description: The listen record this offer or answer belongs to.

stunUrls.description: The ICE servers (STUN URLs) this side gathers with.
